children: GSK plc Sponsored ADR (LSE:GSK) is pressing its oncology and vaccine advantages—pursuing FDA expansion for Jideytro after strong ROS1‑positive NSCLC results and growing SHINGRIX uptake—while reallocating about £2bn to R&D, trimming specialty portfolios and closing its Dresden flu plant to shift production.
GSK Jideytro Data Expands FDA Filing

: GSK reported Jideytro lung cancer data: tumor shrinkage/clearance, durable responses, 90% progression-free at one year. GSK plans FDA filing to expand Jideytro into earlier-line ROS1‑positive NSCLC.
: GSK is cutting costs to free about £2 billion for R&D, targeting HIV long‑acting injectables, oncology and liver disease programs, while focusing its specialty portfolio and commercial execution.
: GSK’s SHINGRIX reached ~45% U.S. penetration and ~12% across 12 major non‑U.S. markets. GSK plans a large trial testing SHINGRIX’s effect on major adverse cardiovascular events to inform labeling.
: GSK (GSK) will close its Dresden flu vaccine plant in summer 2027, risking 641 jobs and shifting production to Ste‑Foy, Canada due to lower demand for egg-based flu vaccines.
